kafie-1901--connecticut.description: An Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper over filler from well-regarded growing regions of the Dominican Republic, the Kafie 1901 Connecticut has been among the house's steadiest sellers since 2014. Mild to medium and well balanced, it shows cream, cinnamon and vanilla with a light spice on the palate; an easy partner for morning coffee or tea.

kafie-1901--san-andres.description: Kafie 1901's San Andrés, now produced at the La Aurora factory, uses a Mexican San Andrés wrapper aged five years and fermented twice. First made box-pressed, it is now a round parejo. Coffee, cocoa and molasses carry a full-flavored smoke with a clean finish and a sharp, clean edge on the retrohale.

kafie-1901--sumatra.description: Kafie 1901 Sumatra was first made in Honduras in 2015 and is now produced at the La Aurora factory, built on tobaccos aged four to five years. It smokes creamy and woody, with sweetness and spice threaded through by nuts and a bright citrus note.

kafie-1901--don-fernando-maduro.description: Named for Don Fernando Kafie, father of founder Dr. Gaby Kafie, this maduro wraps a Nicaraguan Habano maduro leaf around a filler highlighted by rare Dominican Andullo tobacco. Kafie presents it as a bold blend that balances strength with rich flavor; leather and cashew give way to spice, cocoa and coffee before a dry, woody close.

thirds.notes: Leather leads with cashew behind it and a brief tease of pepper on a nutty finish.
Spice, a touch of cocoa, coffee and honey take over as the leathery aroma fades.
Dry wood-chip notes settle in and the profile narrows towards the end.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Kafie 1901 Don Fernando Maduro Torpedo review

kafie-1901--serie-l-natural.description: The Serie L Natural marks Gaby Kafie's fiftieth birthday and seven years in premium cigars, the L being the Roman numeral for fifty. Rolled at La Aurora under a Habano natural wrapper, it is a balanced, layered smoke with enough strength to carry its changes from first light to the finish.
